nodes.label: Weapon CameraObj HMD-Bleed Handoff
nodes.rationale: Defines the core problem of HMD motion bleeding into weapon visuals and the selected DLL-side fix.

nodes.label: nodesArray (Structured Buffer)
nodes.rationale: GPU-driven buffer containing per-object world transforms; the target for the HMD-bleed fix.

nodes.label: CameraObj Property
nodes.rationale: Native engine property used to pose viewmodels relative to the camera; identified as the source of HMD bleed.

nodes.label: weapon.world_orient
nodes.rationale: The DLL-side feature that overrides the gun node rotation to fix HMD bleed.
